content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers

Gumroad, Stripe, and other conventional payment platforms are no longer viable options for digital creators in restricted countries. These platforms impose costly fees, ranging from 7.49% + $0.30 per transaction for Stripe to 10% for Gumroad, and in addition, they require Know Your Customer (KYC) verification for both the seller and the buyer, which can be a lengthy and bureaucratic process. In contrast, the COREMERCH architecture offers a seamless and efficient way to sell digital products without incurring high fees or requiring KYC verification.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Pricing digital products in crypto is straightforward because NOWPayments handles the currency conversion automatically. You set your price in USD. The checkout pulls live exchange rates and displays the exact amount in whichever cryptocurrency the buyer selects. For USDT-denominated products, there is no conversion at all — one dollar in equals one dollar received, minus network fees that typically amount to less than $0.10 on Tron or Solana. You receive the crypto equivalent of your USD price in the wallet you configured in your NOWPayments account. COREMERCH never touches these funds at any point — the wallet is yours from the moment of setup and remains yours unconditionally.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

NOWPayments charges a flat 0.5% fee, which is significantly lower than Gumroad's 10% charge on every sale. At 100 sales per month on a $97 product, the fee difference retains $921. This cost-effective solution allows digital creators to maximize their revenue and invest in their business. With NOWPayments, payments are processed in real-time, ensuring that digital creators receive their earnings promptly and can focus on creating more content.
Deploying a sovereign digital commerce stack using the COREMERCH architecture can retain up to $921 per month in revenue compared to Gumroad's 10% charge on every sale.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

The COREMERCH architecture gives digital creators complete ownership and control over their infrastructure, allowing them to manage their digital commerce stacks independently. With Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, digital creators can automate delivery of their digital products, ensuring a seamless experience for their customers. NOWPayments facilitates automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, eliminating the need for manual processing and reducing the risk of payment disputes.

Digital creators who value cost-effectiveness, sovereignty, and efficiency should choose the COREMERCH architecture, which offers a seamless and efficient way to sell digital products without incurring high fees or requiring KYC verification. Those who prioritize flexibility and scalability should consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which provides all the tools and resources needed to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack.
